title: CopyRequest
description: Which commit to copy, under which name, and which ignored paths to link into the copy.

commit.description: The commit whose files the copy holds. A commit: a full or short hash, or a branch name. It has no .. and does not start with a dash.

name.description: The copy's name: letters, digits and dashes, starting with a letter or digit.

items.description: A path git ignores in the project. A path relative to the project's root. It has no .. and does not start with a dash.

links.description: Paths the copy gets as links to the project's own, such as a folder of installed packages; each must be ignored by git in the project.
